reason: We go to the Salisbury Zoo on Saturdays because it's free, and $16 for a weekend visit is a hard sell next to that. I might use the free first visit, but I wouldn't pay after it.
objection: Weekends are the only time I can go, and that's the $16 price, plus I'd be worried bigger kids will be running wild around my baby even with limited numbers.
would_change_my_mind: A weekend price around $10 to $12, or a clear way to see that the Baby Nook is kept separate from the 5-year-olds on Saturdays.
